# Third-party source included in this release

`nlohmann/json.hpp` is nlohmann/json v3.11.3, retrieved from the upstream release tag at https://github.com/nlohmann/json/blob/v3.11.3/single_include/nlohmann/json.hpp . Its MIT copyright/license notice remains embedded in the file. No OpenSees source or binary is included; OpenSeesPy is an optional external verification dependency.

SuperLU, BLAS and LAPACK are linked from the build environment. Their binaries are not included in the source package. Record exact vendor/version/build options when creating a distributable; this notice is not a complete distribution license review.
